packageRules.description: Group non-major dev dependency bumps into a single weekly PR to cut review noise; covers the shared TypeScript/Storybook/Vitest toolchain across the workspace.
Group all OMC bumps (Dockerfile FROM, CI matrix, version.ts pin) into one PR + label so the omc-update-audit workflow fires.
prBodyNotes: :warning: This bump touches the OMC pin. The `omc-update-audit` workflow will run the integration suite against the new version and post a checklist. Walk the items in `packages/omc-client/docs/audit.md` (section 0 calibration first) before merging.

packageRules.description: Auto-merge low-risk dev dependency patches so the OMC update PRs stay readable.

customManagers.description: Keep SUPPORTED_OMC.primary in version.ts in lock-step with OpenModelica GitHub releases. Renovate matches the regex, looks up the latest non-prerelease v* tag from the OpenModelica repo, and bumps the version in the same PR as the Docker image.
